verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a contract-lifecycle platform could plausibly ship background automations. However, the evidence only shows developer building blocks: the REST API for launching or bulk-launching workflows, event webhooks, and custom integrations that "automatically" push approvals. Nothing documents a first-party, user-configurable automation (scheduled or triggered) that runs autonomously inside Ironclad, and Workflow Designer is only described as something you publish and then launch.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
